messages:
release-bot: Deploy paused: incident detected in eu-west-1 affecting router shards. Canary for release 3.2.1-hotpatch automatically held. Reason: backend 502 spike -> circuit tripping. ACL: hold = true :warning:

alex: saw the alert, thanks. rough impact?

sre_oncall: backend 502s peaked ~11:42 UTC, ~3% of requests. Not catastrophic but correlates with canary traffic bump. We're throttling new rollout traffic.

maya: is this the hotpatch that landed canary at 11:30? we need a decision: continue canary with smaller % or pin and reschedule full rollout?

release-bot: Current canary: 25% traffic -> paused. Suggested options: 1) reduce canary to 5% and monitor 30m; 2) pin version and requeue full rollout to next nightly window (02:00-04:00 UTC); 3) rollback canary to previous stable.

jordan: prefer option 2. This patch touches runtime kernel selection, don't want to mix with infra instability. Requeue to 02:00 and run a 10m smoke before widening.

ops_lead: +1 to requeue. Also want a contingency: if 502s persist at 02:00, auto-abort and mark for manual review.

product: need release notes updated to reflect hotfix behavior and fallback policy. maya can you take?

maya: on it. I'll update draft and tag @product for sign-off.

alex: for clarity, let's pin the artifact to 3.2.1-hotpatch in the release system so we don't accidentally deploy a later build when we requeue. Who can set the pin?

release-bot: Command suggestions:
```
/release pin 3.2.1-hotpatch --reason "incident hold: eu-west-1 502 spike"
/release schedule 3.2.1-hotpatch --window "02:00-04:00 UTC" --smoke 10m --auto-abort-on "502_rate>1%"
```

jordan: I'll run the pin and schedule now.

sre_oncall: also adding a temporary rate-limit rule on the canary route to keep impact low during the follow-up window. will post the rule id.

release-bot: Pin successful: 3.2.1-hotpatch pinned by jordan at 1718634378. Scheduled: 02:00-04:00 UTC, smoke 10m, auto-abort condition set.

maya: release notes updated: added entry "3.2.1-hotpatch: kernel selection fix; gated rollout due to upstream 502s; scheduled retry 02:00 UTC with auto-abort." Draft link: https://redwood.internal/notebook/3.2.1-hotpatch

product: reviewed, approved.

ops_lead: FYI we'll also move non-critical low-latency traffic to fallback region if 502s climb. Jordan, coordinate with infra.

jordan: acknowledged, will script fallback and post runbook excerpt here before 01:45 UTC.

alex: final check — do we want to open a short postmortem ticket now to track incident + release decision?

sre_oncall: yes please, creating INC-2024-511 and linking to the release thread.

release-bot: Postmortem ticket INC-2024-511 created by sre_oncall at 1718634489.

ops_lead: thanks team. We'll reconvene 01:50 UTC for preflight. If anything changes earlier, ping #eng-sre and tag me. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — I'll push the release notes and add the runbook link.

alex: good coordination. marking thread resolved until preflight. :white_check_mark:
